did: I turned the public Pages site into a CV, as the owner asked. Pages is now static pages only: a landing drawn from the résumé's data, the résumé as HTML with a page and a PDF for each version, the record each video's end card links to, and a 404 page. It went from 5.3 MB and about 270 files to under 1 MB, with no app. The landing's slots show real clips and stills when CI has made them: Page Filter's gap, shot on a page of ours, Suspender Ledger's promo, and the phone app's Jobs walk, all on sample data. Each deploy fetches the newest of each from main's own runs, and draws a placeholder when one is missing. The work landed through the coordinator's buckets, PRs 3410, 3412 and 3416, each branch reviewed fresh before it went in. After the merge, Site Assets made the Page Filter still and the extensions clip on its first run. Snips Capture failed before taking any screen, because an earlier change made its specs load JSON that Node refuses without a type; I fixed that on its own branch, with a test that holds it.

calls.title: The public site serves static pages and no app; the résumé reads as HTML with a PDF download
options: keep the app on Pages for the résumé and the authorship record
static pages that embed the PDF on a desktop
static pages in HTML at every width, with the PDF a download
calls.why: A CV needs no app, and the HTML reads on a phone and is found by search; the PDF stays one click away for each version.
calls.undo: Give the Pages build the app's index.html entry again and write it as 404.html.

calls.title: How the landing's clips and stills reach the Pages build
options: an artifact per kind, made by CI on sample data and fetched at each deploy
media pinned by commit in paulgsc/testing
everything rendered inside the Pages workflow
calls.why: It commits no media and needs no storage, and a missing piece only shows its drawing.
calls.undo: Delete the Site Assets workflow, the APK clip job and the Pages fetch step; every slot draws its placeholder.

calls.title: The desktop strip stops claiming the Practice and Jobs wings publish anything
options: name the essays' snips as where they go public
leave them until the owner says
calls.why: Pages no longer carries those screens, so the lines claimed a publication that isn't there.
calls.undo: Bring the Published field and line back from git history, then give the wings their lines.

calls.title: The landing's clips get the browser's own controls
options: a poster still played on a tap
calls.why: Anyone can pause a looping clip, someone who prefers less motion included, and the page still runs no script.
calls.undo: Drop controls from the clip's video tag.

left: Checking the live site after the deploy: it waits on the owner's approval of the Pages release, and the steps are written on epic 3401.
The Snips Capture fix (branch claude/pages-snips-json) is a defect, so it goes as its own PR, never in a bucket; after it merges, one more dispatch should make the APK clip.
The server clip and the cores still: they would send home's dashboards to GitHub, which is the owner's to allow (ask 3415).
A poster still, or a first frame for people who prefer less motion, for the clips: a later story.
The photo slot still holds the mochi until the owner adds a portrait.
